SELECT t.company, t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_quarter, t.calendar_quarter, t.days,
       t.revenue AS revenue,
       t.inventory AS inventory
FROM (SELECT p.company_id AS company, p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_quarter, p.calendar_quarter, p.days,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'inventory' THEN f.value END) AS inventory,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'revenue' THEN f.value END) AS revenue
FROM facts f
JOIN periods p USING (company_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter)
WHERE f.version = 'original' AND p.company_id IN ('Lenovo') AND (p.fiscal_year > 2025 OR (p.fiscal_year = 2025 AND p.fiscal_quarter >= 2)) AND (p.fiscal_year < 2025 OR (p.fiscal_year = 2025 AND p.fiscal_quarter <= 2))
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) t
ORDER BY t.company, t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_quarter

SELECT t.company, t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_quarter, t.calendar_quarter, t.days,
       t.accounts_payable AS accounts_payable,
       t.accounts_receivable AS accounts_receivable,
       t.accrued_liabilities AS accrued_liabilities,
       t.cash AS cash,
       t.deferred_revenue_current AS deferred_revenue_current,
       t.deferred_revenue_noncurrent AS deferred_revenue_noncurrent,
       t.financing_receivables AS financing_receivables,
       t.goodwill AS goodwill,
       t.intangibles AS intangibles,
       t.inventory AS inventory,
       t.long_term_debt AS long_term_debt,
       t.other_current_assets AS other_current_assets,
       t.other_current_liabilities AS other_current_liabilities,
       t.other_noncurrent_assets AS other_noncurrent_assets,
       t.other_noncurrent_liabilities AS other_noncurrent_liabilities,
       t.ppe_net AS ppe_net,
       t.short_term_debt AS short_term_debt,
       t.short_term_investments AS short_term_investments,
       t.total_assets AS total_assets,
       t.total_current_assets AS total_current_assets,
       t.total_current_liabilities AS total_current_liabilities,
       t.total_equity AS total_equity,
       t.total_liabilities AS total_liabilities
FROM (SELECT p.company_id AS company, p.fiscal_year, p.fiscal_quarter, p.calendar_quarter, p.days,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'accounts_payable' THEN f.value END) AS accounts_payable,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'accounts_receivable' THEN f.value END) AS accounts_receivable,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'accrued_liabilities' THEN f.value END) AS accrued_liabilities,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'cash' THEN f.value END) AS cash,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'deferred_revenue_current' THEN f.value END) AS deferred_revenue_current,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'deferred_revenue_noncurrent' THEN f.value END) AS deferred_revenue_noncurrent,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'financing_receivables' THEN f.value END) AS financing_receivables,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'goodwill' THEN f.value END) AS goodwill,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'intangibles' THEN f.value END) AS intangibles,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'inventory' THEN f.value END) AS inventory,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'long_term_debt' THEN f.value END) AS long_term_debt,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'other_current_assets' THEN f.value END) AS other_current_assets,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'other_current_liabilities' THEN f.value END) AS other_current_liabilities,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'other_noncurrent_assets' THEN f.value END) AS other_noncurrent_assets,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'other_noncurrent_liabilities' THEN f.value END) AS other_noncurrent_liabilities,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'ppe_net' THEN f.value END) AS ppe_net,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'short_term_debt' THEN f.value END) AS short_term_debt,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'short_term_investments' THEN f.value END) AS short_term_investments,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'total_assets' THEN f.value END) AS total_assets,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'total_current_assets' THEN f.value END) AS total_current_assets,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'total_current_liabilities' THEN f.value END) AS total_current_liabilities,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'total_equity' THEN f.value END) AS total_equity,
       MAX(CASE WHEN f.account_code = 'total_liabilities' THEN f.value END) AS total_liabilities
FROM facts f
JOIN periods p USING (company_id, fiscal_year, fiscal_quarter)
WHERE f.version = 'original' AND p.company_id IN ('Lenovo') AND (p.fiscal_year > 2025 OR (p.fiscal_year = 2025 AND p.fiscal_quarter >= 2)) AND (p.fiscal_year < 2025 OR (p.fiscal_year = 2025 AND p.fiscal_quarter <= 2))
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5) t
ORDER BY t.company, t.fiscal_year, t.fiscal_quarter
